## Raw Concept

Eight corpus PDFs reference eLearnSecurity certifications (eCPPT, eCPTXv2, eWPT, eWPTX, eCXD, eCIR, Mobile, ExploitDev).

## Narrative

Italian-founded cybersecurity training vendor (acquired by INE in 2020, now operates as INE Security). Offers a deep certification ladder — eJPT (entry) → eCPPT (mid) → eCPTX (advanced) for pentest; eWPT → eWPTX for web app; eMAPT for mobile; eCDFP / eCIR for DFIR / IR. [CONFIRMED]

**Position vs OffSec:** more permissive lab access, longer take-home format, heavier emphasis on **reporting quality**. Often paired with OSCP in career paths (eCPPT first for foundation, OSCP second for credential weight).
